rules: Constitution II and docs/agent-workflow.md: inward dependencies, explicit SDK owners, inert imports and adapter-owned effects. Native asset writes alone may use SDK roots outside CY_HOME.

modules.responsibility: Immutable native asset requests and preparation results
modules.interface: Typed values, identities and result records; no effects

modules.responsibility: Validation, cache promotion and URL resolution
modules.interface: resolve_asset(AssetSpec) returns actual ResolvedAsset; incomplete files never published
modules.effects: Owns URL retrieval, destination locks, validation dispatch and atomic file publication; receives explicit native roots and never changes SDK settings.

modules.interface: Native root and single filename produce confined native leaf without CY_HOME restriction
modules.effects: Owns native-root containment checks and temporary sibling copy/fsync/replace; performs no network calls or SDK configuration writes.

modules.responsibility: HF native cache and endpoint ownership
modules.interface: Resolve HubAsset using native metadata and endpoint-scoped credentials
allowed_dependencies: standard-library context/thread coordination and third-party diagnostic logging boundary
modules.effects: Owns endpoint-scoped HF SDK calls, native cache locks, validated blobs/configuration/refs/snapshots and compatible legacy promotion; never mutates SDK global selectors. Scopes third-party diagnostic redaction to the active SDK context, coordinating temporary filters without altering unrelated thread output or persistent logger configuration.

modules.responsibility: Catalogue preparation and durable attempt state
modules.interface: prepare_catalogue(*, automatic: bool) -> PreparationResult; completion-only receipts
modules.effects: Owns runtime SDK discovery orchestration, per-asset resolver calls, catalogue locking and atomic completed-attempt receipts beneath CY_HOME; no import-time preparation.

modules.interface: Named asset to AssetSpec using effective weights_dir and release identity
modules.effects: Reads effective Ultralytics settings and installed native release/name helpers at runtime; no model construction, settings writes or downloads.

modules.interface: pretrained_asset preserves source choice and SDK cache locations
modules.effects: Reads installed Torchvision/timm pretrained descriptors and native Torch/HF cache selection at runtime, including native source precedence; no settings writes or model construction.

modules.interface: pretrained_asset returns registry filename and native cache
modules.effects: Imports native RF-DETR asset registry and reads filenames/checksums/cache selection at runtime; no model construction, settings writes or downloads.

modules.interface: main help no effects; explicit retry reports failures and exits nonzero
modules.effects: Owns argument parsing, runtime bootstrap, explicit manual adapter invocation, redacted console reporting and process exit status; storage/network remain adapter-owned.

modules.interface: Only actual pipeline execution triggers automatic preparation before construction
modules.effects: Owns invocation policy: calls preparation only during actual pipeline execution before existing model/configuration materialization; preserves standalone and inspection paths.

modules.responsibility: Shared content validation independent of transport
modules.interface: validate_asset(Path, AssetSpec) -> SHA256; rejects invalid content
modules.effects: Reads and hashes files, validates archive/safetensors/checkpoint structure; performs no writes, downloads or model construction.

modules.responsibility: Bounded HTTP downloads and credential-safe asset source diagnostics
modules.interface: asset_source_url retains only public Google Drive identity query; other query/credentials redacted
modules.effects: Owns HTTP file streaming; source diagnostic helper is pure.

contracts.rules: Exhaustive layers and entrypoints; exact SDK ownership and peer bridges; inward core/application dependencies.
Dynamic imports, forbidden SDK/core/queue edges, effects, inert initializers and injected negative graph checks.

checks.expectation: Static checks, import contracts, ordinary suite and architecture negative cases pass.
Markdown and local links pass, changed examples checked.

checks.command: Feature 007 native acceptance harness documented in verification.md
checks.expectation: Real prefetched assets load offline via normal native loaders and custom configuration.

checks.command: Normal paired editable install and cy-queue integration/static checks per docs/development.md
checks.expectation: Latest CY and queue sources/installed versions and proposed release compatible.

documentation: README, model-assets/filesystem/project contracts, current index and authoritative portable clearml-yolo usage/evaluation source; dated verification records mutation applicability. Native release-generated CHANGELOG.md and root version metadata are included in final scope reconciliation.

review.reviewer: Fresh full-scope final_review and acceptance_review; focused privacy_acceptance/privacy_final with final ship closure; parent reconciled all results
review.reconciliation: Inspected complete isolated feature007 tracked/untracked diff: core/adapters/entrypoints, metadata, exact import contracts, tests, user/contract docs and native feature artifacts. Byte-identical task-owned capture excludes concurrent feature008 and all unrelated shared-checkout edits. All confirmed findings have real-path regression and fresh independent closure; Executed canonical, native, paired and documentation results are reconciled separately before acceptance.
